card.name: Partway through long uncommon words
card.fires_on: Fires on a piece in the middle of a long or unusual word that is still unfinished, such as the B in EXACERBATION or the ul in immunoglobulins. Also seen inside place names and non-Latin script.

modes.label: Capitalized warning word
modes.description: The B inside EXACERBATION in the all-caps hepatitis B boxed warning.
modes.example: WARNING: POST TREATMENT ACUTE EXACER<<B>>ATION OF HEPATITIS B

modes.label: Medical term
modes.description: Middle piece of a long lowercase medical word.
modes.example: perform testing for quantitative serum immunoglob<<ul>>ins [see Warnings and Preca

modes.label: Place name
modes.description: Middle piece of a proper name in general text.
modes.example: the grand duke of T<<usc>>any, Cosimo I de’ Med

card.writes: It adds little visible output; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, though it pushes against spaces and punctuation since the word is not finished.
card.plain: It activates when a long word is split and only part of it has been read, so the word is still unfinished.
